title: Porsche 911 Carrera 4 / Carrera 2 (964) — Workshop manual, Volume I, Engine
notes: Volume I (Engine) of the 964 workshop manual. It is the same « Ultimate Tech Resource » PDF compilation as SRC-PORSCHE-WORKSHOP-MANUAL-964-VOL4-CHASSIS and -VOL5-BODY. The local copy has 247 pages, is 39 382 555 bytes, and has SHA-256 5833f0e6ee0225fcde850c0b5b43664bbac52dc41c2e8304b99baa57e00959b0. It is a scan with almost no text layer. The file is not committed to the repository: only values are transcribed, each with its page reference. The Carrera 4 is the base text. The Carrera 2 deviations follow a separator sheet and are paginated from 100. The table of contents was read on 2026-10-07 and gives these sections: technical data 0-2, tightening torques 10-1, crankcase, crankshaft and con rods 13-1 to 13-47 (normal and rework crankshaft dimensions 13-6, con-rod weight groups 13-9, pistons and cylinders dimensions and identification 13-42a), cylinder head and valve drive 15-1 to 15-21 (camshaft housing 15-10a, head refacing 15-10e, valve guides 15-10f, angle-controlled head tightening 15-16), lubrication group 17, fuel group 20, injection group 24, exhaust group 26, starter and generator group 27, and ignition group 28. Page 0-2 states the internal engine designation M 64/01 (USA values in brackets, also M 64/01): 6 cylinders, bore 100 mm, stroke 76.4 mm, 3600 cm3, compression 11.0:1. Scope limit: this is the 964 engine, M64/01. The 993 engines (M64/05 and M64/06 naturally aspirated, M64/60 Turbo) share the M64 family but are not covered. Any value used for a 993 or M64/60 part must be checked against SRC-PORSCHE-WORKSHOP-MANUAL-993 or measured before it becomes an interface; it must not be applied by family resemblance alone. Only the table of contents and pages 0-1 and 0-2 have been read so far: no dimension has been transcribed yet.
